en: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Nafi Ziryab
ar: أبو الحسن علي بن نافع زرياب

description.tr: Üç çeşit yemek düzenini, mevsimlik modayı, diş macununu ve beş telli udu icat etti — Bağdat'tan Endülüs'e Avrupa sosyal adetlerini tek başına dönüştürdü || Ziryâb, İslam medeniyetinin Avrupa üzerindeki kültürel boyutunu temsil eder. Yenilikleri teknolojik değil sosyaldi: yemek adabı, mevsimlik gardırop değişiklikleri, kişisel hijyen standartları ve müzik teorisi. || [Tarih notu] Tarihsel Ziryâb'ı efsaneden ayırmak zordur, çünkü kaynakların çoğu yüzyıllar sonrasıdır. el-Makkarî'nin Nefhu't-Tîb'i (17. yy.) en kapsamlı anlatımdır.
description.en: Invented the three-course meal, seasonal fashion, toothpaste, and the five-string oud — single-handedly transformed European social customs from Baghdad to Andalusia || Ziryab represents the cultural dimension of Islamic civilization's impact on Europe. His innovations were not technological but social: dining etiquette, seasonal wardrobe changes, personal hygiene standards, and musical theory. He established a conservatory in Córdoba that trained generations of musicians and introduced the 24 Andalusian nubat — the classical music system that influenced troubadour tradition. || [Historiographical note] The historical Ziryab is difficult to separate from legend, as most sources are centuries later. Al-Maqqari's Nafh al-Tib (17th c.) is the fullest account. Reynolds (2009) attempted to reconstruct the historical core from earlier fragments.
description.ar: اخترع الوجبة ذات الثلاثة أطباق والموضة الموسمية ومعجون الأسنان والعود ذا الخمسة أوتار || زرياب يمثل البعد الثقافي لتأثير الحضارة الإسلامية على أوروبا. ابتكاراته اجتماعية لا تكنولوجية: آداب المائدة والأزياء الموسمية ومعايير النظافة الشخصية ونظرية الموسيقى
